identity.mail.confirm-email.customer.sub: Confirm your email for your MondaPac customer account
identity.mail.confirm-email.customer.bod: Open the link below and enter your password to confirm your email and sign in. The link works for {duration} and only once.
identity.mail.confirm-email.seller.subje: Confirm your email for your MondaPac seller account
identity.mail.confirm-email.seller.body: Open the link below and enter your password to confirm your email and sign in to your seller account. The link works for {duration} and only once.
You already have a MondaPac customer account
Someone tried to create a MondaPac customer account with this email. You already have one, so nothing was changed. If you forgot your password, you can reset it on the sign-in page.
identity.mail.existing-account.seller.su: You already have a MondaPac seller account
identity.mail.existing-account.seller.bo: Someone tried to create a MondaPac seller account with this email. You already have one, so nothing was changed. If you forgot your password, you can reset it on the sign-in page.
identity.mail.welcome.seller.subject: Welcome to MondaPac: your seller account
identity.mail.welcome.seller.heading: Welcome to MondaPac
identity.mail.welcome.seller.body: Your email is confirmed and your seller account is set up. We're reviewing your application and will email you when there's a decision. Until then you can sign in to see its status.
identity.mail.welcome.seller.body.no-app: Your email is confirmed and your seller account is ready. Sign in to go to your seller panel.
identity.mail.reset-password.customer.su: Reset the password for your MondaPac customer account
identity.mail.reset-password.customer.bo: Open the link below to choose a new password. The link works for {duration} and only once. Choosing a new password signs you out everywhere.
identity.mail.reset-password.seller.subj: Reset the password for your MondaPac seller account
identity.mail.reset-password.seller.head: Reset your password
identity.mail.reset-password.seller.body: Open the link below to choose a new password for your seller account. The link works for {duration} and only once. Choosing a new password signs you out everywhere.
The password for your MondaPac customer account was changed
The password for your customer account was changed on {time}. Your other open sessions have been signed out.
identity.mail.password-changed.seller.su: The password for your MondaPac seller account was changed
identity.mail.password-changed.seller.bo: The password for your seller account was changed on {time}. Your other open sessions have been signed out.
identity.mail.common.account-line.custom: This email is about your customer account. A seller account with the same email is separate.
identity.mail.common.account-line.seller: This email is about your seller account. A customer account with the same email is separate.
identity.mail.common.ignore: If you didn't ask for this, you can ignore this email.
identity.mail.common.not-you: If this wasn't you, reset your password from the sign-in page straight away.
identity.mail.common.footer: This is an automatic message from MondaPac. Replies are not read.
